fit_hand_3d_pose: fit a 3D hand pose model from 21 joint coordinates using the wrapper_hand_model fit3d method
fit_hand_2d_pose: fit a 2D hand pose model from 21 joint coordinates with camera calibration using the fit2d method
render_hand_model: render an OpenGL visualization of the fitted hand model as a PIL Image using the render method
reset_hand_model_values: reset the hand model translation, pose, and coefficient parameters to default values using reset_value
set_camera_calibration: set the camera calibration matrix K for the hand model wrapper using the set_calibK method
